citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
In March 2026, only one member of the IACUC conducted the semi-annual facility inspection. Additionally, there has been
drift in the timeline for the semi-annual facility inspections with the proceeding inspection occurring in August 2025 (7
months) and the one before that occurring in December 2024 (8 months). Facility inspections must be conducted every 6
months, in person, by at least 2 members of the IACUC, provided no one who wants to participate is excluded. In person
inspections by a minimum of 2 people allow for different perspectives that produce a more thorough and complete
assessment. Conducting inspections at a 6 month frequency ensures timely correction of deficiencies. Correct by
ensuring at least 2 members of the IACUC conduct in-person facility inspections at the next semi-annual review, no later
than September 30, 2026.

citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
The IACUC did not prepare reports regarding the facility’s program review and inspection of the animal facilities, for
submission to the Institutional Official during the last review. A semi-annual review was completed in March 2026,
however, a report of the evaluations was never prepared or submitted to the Institutional Official.
Every six months, upon completion of the program review and facility inspection, the IACUC must provide reports of its
evaluations to the Institutional Official to ensure that they are aware of the current status of the animal program, facilities,
and procedures.
After completing the program review and the inspection of the animal facilities, the IACUC must prepare reports of their
evaluations that a majority of members must sign, and submit the reports to the Institutional Official. Correct by next semi
annual review, no later than September 30, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
